title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 3: Everyday events: what I did

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Hier, j'ai pris le train pour Gatineau et j'ai lu un avis sur le quai.
steps.question: Where did the speaker read the notice?
steps.explain: The speaker says sur le quai, on the platform.

steps.fr: J'ai fait une demande au guichet, puis j'ai pris le reçu.
steps.question: What did the speaker take?
steps.explain: The second action is taking the receipt.

steps.fr: Nous avons vu le numéro de la station et pris la bonne correspondance.
steps.question: What helped the speakers choose the connection?
steps.explain: They saw the station number before taking the connection.

steps.fr: À la fin de l'atelier, j'ai eu une réponse claire à ma question.
steps.question: When did the speaker get a clear answer?
options: At the end of the workshop
steps.explain: The recording begins à la fin de l'atelier.

steps.fr: D'abord, j'ai lu la consigne. Ensuite, j'ai fait l'activité dans mon cahier.
steps.question: What did the speaker do after reading the instruction?
options: Completed the activity in a notebook
Took a bus to the station
steps.explain: The next action was doing the activity in a notebook.
